_note: Our own writing. A soldier of the hub's garrison (Soldiers): the law here, what they've seen, and a warning if the squad's been trouble.

greet.speaker: npc
line: Lancers. Keep it peaceful and we'll get along.

wary.speaker: npc
line: I know your face. We're watching you.
Half the town's talking about you. Walk carefully.

choices.text: Seen anything strange on your rounds?

law.speaker: npc
line: No fights in the street, no taking what isn't yours, and nobody goes into a private room uninvited. Break any of those where we can see, and we'll come for you.
Keep your weapons holstered and your hands to yourself. The night watch doesn't ask twice.

seen.speaker: npc
line: Lights in the back office after dark, some nights. Not my business who's working late.
Somebody's been sleeping rough by the landing pads. Might be nothing.
Quiet, mostly. The bar gets loud after dark. That's where trouble starts, if it starts.

pushed.speaker: npc
line: I keep the peace. Who pays for it is above my pay grade.
